CORS is wide open (`*`), so the page works from a local file. The dashboard is now open in your browser at [dashboard.html](file:///Users/sabpap/Workspace/Clients/Laurium/pod-ai-variants/2-manual/dashboard.html) [📁](file:///Users/sabpap/Workspace/Clients/Laurium/pod-ai-variants/2-manual/).

Here's what it does:

- **Account section** — shows your account value ($19.72), cash, and unrealized P&L, updated live via `pod_positions`
- **Market cards** — NVDA, AAPL, and GLD with mark price, 24h change, oracle, last trade, high/low, volume, open interest, and funding rate, updated live via `pod_markets`
- **Positions table** — currently empty (no open positions); will populate live when you open a position
- **NVDA 1% alert** — when the mark price moves 1% from its anchor (resets after each alert), it fires a banner on the page and a browser notification (the page will ask for notification permission)

All numbers are converted with BigInt (no floating-point truncation). The WebSocket subscribes with `since` from the REST snapshot, drops repeated rounds, heartbeats every 30s, and auto-reconnects with exponential backoff.
